cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I don't need a fuss for my birthday. Just come here instead of the concert; I've made your favourite cake and put dinner back for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring your friend. I'll feed you both and pay for the tickets; nobody needs to make a speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only agreed because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll clear the living room before you arrive. You two choose the music. I'll cut the cake during the first slow song, if you'll save that dance for me.

reason: Make S06 act through a specific modest role and practical decisions about access, timing, presentation or resources. Preserve the original Drive response chain where sound; remove reviewer-facing outcome language.
